title: Jets have clear vision for ‘exciting’ first-rounder David Bailey — and aren’t buying his pre-draft knock

sources.title: Jets have clear vision for ‘exciting’ first-rounder David Bailey — and aren’t buying his pre-draft knock
sources.description: The knock on David Bailey during the pre-draft process was that while he was an elite pass rusher, he was not a good run defender.
